name: Websidian
description: Connect OpenClaw to Websidian (an Obsidian vault served as a website): guard writes so vault notes stay plain Markdown and agent instruction files need human approval, share view/edit links for the notes the agent writes, and serve the vaults behind the Gateway.

vaults.description: Vaults served by Websidian. Each entry: {path, url?, slug?, title?, edit?, untrusted?}. path is the vault folder; url an external Websidian site base including the slug (links point there); slug/title name the site the plugin serves itself; edit (default false) enables browser editing; untrusted (default true) keeps agent-written HTML inert.

protect.description: Basename patterns of agent instruction files that need human approval (default: SKILL.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, BOOTSTRAP.md).

protectMode.description: approve (ask a human through plugin approvals) or block.

blockActiveContent.description: Block raw active HTML and .html/.svg/.js files in vault writes (default true).

appendLinks.description: Append 'Notes updated:' view/edit links to outgoing replies (default true).

ui.description: The Websidian pages served behind the Gateway at /plugins/websidian/.

enabled.description: Run a Websidian server for the vaults and proxy it at /plugins/websidian/w/<slug>/ (default true).

port.description: Loopback port of the supervised Websidian process (default 8095).

dataDir.description: Where the generated config, secrets, cache and log live (default <state dir>/plugin-data/websidian).

node.description: Node executable used for the supervised server (default: the Gateway's own node).

publicBase.description: How browsers reach the Gateway, used in links (default http://127.0.0.1:<gateway port>).

auth.description: Sign-in for the pages: gateway (the Gateway token or password, default) or password (ui.password).

password.description: Password for the pages when ui.auth is "password".

sessionHours.description: How long a browser sign-in lasts (default 12).

memory.description: The native Memory page in OpenClaw's Control UI, served at /plugins/websidian-memory.

enabled.description: Register the Memory page and its Control UI tab (default true).

vault.description: Slug of the vault the Memory page reads; default the first vault this plugin serves itself.

icon.description: Icon name hint for the sidebar entry (default "brain").

order.description: Sort order among plugin tabs; lower renders first (default 20).
